title: PHP2Shell: unauthenticated PHP core RCEs under exploitation attempts, still not in CISA KEV; reliable exploitation disputed
why: Amazon, Arctic Wolf and others report in-the-wild exploit attempts with second-stage payload delivery, and public PoCs exist; CISA added two other CVEs to KEV on Oct 23 but not PHP2Shell, so it is still missing from KEV.
action: Upgrade PHP to 8.5.12/8.4.27/8.3.36/8.2.35 and set session.upload_progress.enabled=0 until CVE-2026-115560 is fixed.
product: PHP 5.4 through 8.5.11 (fixed 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8.2.35); CVE-2026-115560 unpatched, non-default config

title: Langflow unauthenticated RCEs exploited in the wild but not in CISA KEV; Metasploit ships six Langflow modules
why: VulnCheck reports in-the-wild exploitation of CVE-2026-0768/0769 and Metasploit added weaponized modules Oct 23; none were among CISA's Oct 23-24 KEV additions, so still not in KEV. Not re-searched this run.
action: Upgrade Langflow to the fixed release and remove internet exposure of Langflow instances; hunt for unexpected flow/code execution.

title: Node2Shell: Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write, RCE demonstrated on official Node.js image; flaw also reaches Envoy, Bun, PyPI and Perl bundles
why: Public PoC plus Imperva's RCE demonstration on the unmodified official image; no in-the-wild exploitation reported as of Oct 23 and not in CISA KEV.
action: Upgrade Node.js to 22.23.4/24.22.1/26.12.1 (rebuild container images) and inventory other bundled Brotli copies (Envoy, Bun, Python wheels, Perl).

title: Splunk Enterprise unauthenticated RCE via Patroni REST API on search head cluster members: public PoC with mass-exploit mode
why: Public GitHub PoC and ProjectDiscovery template exist; not in CISA KEV (absent from Oct 23 KEV additions). No in-the-wild reports as of last check Oct 23.
action: Upgrade to Splunk Enterprise 10.4.3/10.2.7 and block the Patroni REST port (~8008) from untrusted networks.
product: Splunk Enterprise search head cluster members before 10.4.3 / 10.2.7

title: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL injection zero-day: now added to CISA KEV
action: Patch VCO to the fixed builds and review operator accounts and audit logs for abuse.

title: FortiSIEM unauthenticated gRPC path traversal to RCE: public PoC, still not in CISA KEV
why: Public PoC for an unauthenticated RCE in a widely deployed Fortinet product; not in CISA KEV (absent from Oct 23 KEV additions), no in-the-wild reports as of last check.
action: Apply Fortinet's FortiSIEM fix and restrict access to FortiSIEM service ports.

title: Pillow EPS/Ghostscript argument injection to command execution (CVSS 9.2), fixed in Pillow 13.0.0
why: Advisory includes a public reproduction; not in CISA KEV and no in-the-wild reports as of Oct 23.
action: Upgrade Pillow to 13.0.0+ and remove Ghostscript from image-processing hosts that do not need EPS.

title: Linux kernel skb_zerocopy local root (ZDI-CAN-33367): public PoC bypasses Dirty Frag fix; AlmaLinux ships testing kernels, still no CVE
why: Working PoC public on netdev; TuxCare verified root on AlmaLinux, Debian and Ubuntu. No CVE, upstream fix not merged, not in CISA KEV.
action: Block esp4/esp6 modules or set user.max_user_namespaces=0 where possible; install distro kernel updates as they ship.
product: Linux kernel since 3.14 (skb_zerocopy), incl. kernels with Dirty Frag CVE-2026-43284 fix

title: Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server (Nextcloud richdocumentscode) unauthenticated command injection exploited to plant web shells (KEV)
action: Update richdocumentscode to 26.4.303+ or remove it, then hunt for shx*.php web shells and proxy.php?status injection requests back to Sep 10.
product: richdocumentscode (Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server) before 26.4.303

title: BlackX UEFI bootkit (APT41-linked) bypasses Secure Boot on patched Windows lacking Baton Drop revocations
action: Apply Microsoft's CVE-2023-24932 / Baton Drop Secure Boot revocation steps (DBX, PCA 2011) in a staged rollout and verify revocation status.
product: Windows with Secure Boot where PCA 2011 / Baton Drop DBX revocations are not applied

title: GitLab unauthenticated RCE via Onigmo regex bug (CVSS 10): Ruby ships upstream fixes; any Ruby app compiling untrusted regex affected
why: Vendor-confirmed unauthenticated RCE, now widened to any Ruby app compiling attacker-controlled regex; THN: none of the four GitLab CVEs in CISA KEV as of Oct 23; no public PoC or ITW.
action: Upgrade self-managed GitLab to the Oct 21 releases and Ruby runtimes to 4.0.9/3.4.12/3.3.13; audit Regexp.new on user input.
product: GitLab CE/EE 7.0+ (fixed 19.5.1, 19.4.3, 19.3.6 and backports); Ruby before 4.0.9 / 3.4.12 / 3.3.13

title: Unpatched Linux KSMBD RCEs (ZDI-CAN-33774 pre-auth, ZDI-CAN-33549 SMB Direct, CVSS 9.0) public on LKML with no mainline fix
why: Detailed ZDI reports leaked to public LKML; no mainline fix, no CVE, not in CISA KEV; public PoCs show crash/leak only.
action: Unload/disable ksmbd where not needed and block TCP 445 from untrusted networks.

title: HPE Aruba AOS-8/AOS-10: eight max-severity unauthenticated auth-bypass/RCE flaws among 72 CVEs (HPESBNW05162)
why: Vendor advisory for max-severity unauthenticated flaws in widely deployed edge gear; no PoC/ITW yet and not in CISA KEV.
action: Upgrade AOS-8/AOS-10 controllers and gateways to the fixed releases and restrict management interfaces.

title: NGINX heap overflows/UAF (CVSS4 9.2) allow unauthenticated DoS and possible RCE in specific configurations
why: F5 out-of-band advisory K000163408 and oss-security disclosure of unauthenticated memory corruption in the most deployed reverse proxy; no in-the-wild use, no public PoC and not in CISA KEV.
action: Upgrade NGINX to 1.30.6/1.31.7 (or F5 fixed builds) and review configs with nginx -T for alias/map/aio usage.
product: NGINX Open Source before 1.30.6 / 1.31.7 (ranges per CVE); NGINX Plus 37.0.0-37.0.4; Ingress Controller, Gateway Fabric, Instance Manager
